# SYNTHETIC test data, not a capture from any device.
#
# The Wi-Fi block as an adapter that HAS a signal level publishes it: a level
# in dBm alongside the link quality, the bitrate and the two counters. It is
# the counterpart of metrics-wifi-8189fs.txt, which carries the same block
# from an adapter with no level to give, and the pair is what the measure
# choice is tested against — same panel, same five possible readings, and a
# different answer to "what can this chart honestly plot".
#
# The values are chosen to be unremarkable: a level in the middle of the good
# band, a quality likewise, and counters at rest.
# HELP wifi_link_quality_ratio Wi-Fi link quality, percent of the driver's own maximum
# TYPE wifi_link_quality_ratio gauge
wifi_link_quality_ratio 88
# HELP wifi_retries_total Wi-Fi transmit retries
# TYPE wifi_retries_total counter
wifi_retries_total 0
# HELP wifi_missed_beacons_total Wi-Fi beacons missed from the associated AP
# TYPE wifi_missed_beacons_total counter
wifi_missed_beacons_total 0
# HELP wifi_rssi_dbm Wi-Fi signal strength (RSSI) at the station, dBm
# TYPE wifi_rssi_dbm gauge
wifi_rssi_dbm -54
# HELP wifi_bitrate_mbps Wi-Fi negotiated bitrate, Mbit/s
# TYPE wifi_bitrate_mbps gauge
wifi_bitrate_mbps 72.2
